metadata.description: Spark — a focused core that turns Codex or Claude Code and GitHub into a software delivery system (ideate, plan, codify, validate, ship), plus companion plugins for auditing, service connectivity, and public docs.

plugins.name: spark
plugins.description: The core: one-command carry-in (setup), project inception (bootstrap), the five-stage lifecycle, three-tier preferences, session brief/resume with durable work state, mechanical git enforcement, doctor, and Release Please scaffolding.

plugins.name: spark-audit
plugins.description: Whole-project assessment (assess) and evidence-backed cleanup (purge) behind a human approval gate.

plugins.name: spark-connect
plugins.description: Service connectivity and secrets bootstrap via 1Password: capture, verify, shred; provider recipes included.

plugins.name: spark-docs
plugins.description: Public docs and positioning through author personas under an honest-hype contract: README, philosophy, visuals, launch copy.
